rows.solution: Both circles are shaded except the region they share, so the shaded region is \((A - B) \cup (B - A)\), the symmetric difference \(A \,\Delta\, B\). It is not \(A \cap B\) (that region is unshaded), not \(A \cup B\) (which includes the common region) and not \(B - A\) (part of A is also shaded). Hence (D) None of these.
